create_jsonqa_dataset: create a JsonQADataset from JSON files to load QA pairs with positive and negative passages
create_jsonlqa_dataset: create a JsonlQADataset from JSONL files to stream load QA pairs with lazy subset loading
parse_nq_tables: parse Natural Questions HTML table tokens using NQTableParser to extract structured Table objects
read_nq_tables_jsonl: read a JSONL file of NQ table data and return a dictionary of parsed Table objects
split_tables_to_chunks: split a dictionary of Table objects into text chunks with a configurable max table length
